prompt:

name: Sled Hack Squat (45-degree linear sled hack squat)
camera: Side three-quarter view facing right, showing athlete in a 45-degree sled hack squat machine
equipment: 45-degree sled hack squat machine with angled backrest pad, shoulder pads, footplate, and side safety handles
positionA: Left panel: Athlete stands in hack squat carriage with back and shoulders firmly supported under pads, legs extended with knees softly unlocked, feet flat on footplate shoulder-width apart (start position at top of rails).
positionB: Right panel: EXACT SAME machine carriage and footplate. Athlete lowers into deep squat by bending knees and hips until thighs are parallel to the footplate (~90 degrees knee flexion); back and hips remain firmly glued to backrest pad; knees track over toes.
mechanics: Guided linear hack squat isolating quadriceps along 45-degree carriage rails. Back remains supported throughout.
avoid: Do not show free barbell squat, no hips lifting off backrest pad, no extra limbs, no text/labels/arrows.
checks: Identity and proportions match the original style references
Both poses show the same equipment and geometry
Cuffs and other attachments are visibly connected as specified
Movement, limb count and support positions are plausible
No cropped equipment, logos, text, gradients or muscle activation percentages
